description: GST Invoice Maker creates GST-compliant bills for Indian shops, restaurants, kiranas, and freelancers. Ask for a bill in plain language and get computed totals plus a link that opens the bill fully filled in — ready to print or save as PDF. Also provides ready-made downloadable bill format PDFs and a GST reference guide (required invoice fields, rate slabs). Free, no account needed, and bill data is processed in-memory — never stored.

defaultPrompt: Make a GST bill for my shop: 2 notebooks at ₹240 with 12% GST
Show me downloadable GST bill formats for my restaurant
